notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander.
Repeat.
